# StrategyDiffusionCoupling

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The coupling of strategy update rules (e.g., replicator dynamics) with spatial diffusion of agents or signals across a neuromorphic substrate. Guides implementation of adaptive learning rules in in-network neuromorphic hardware where local diffusion can replace global reward signals.
